transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I'm just tired. Mostly I came in because I'm tired in a way that doesn't really make sense. I mean, I sleep fine, I keep up at work, but... I still feel like I'm running on a low battery before the day even gets going.
Do you feel sad or down most of the time?

I wouldn't really call it sad. It's more of a... flat feeling, I guess. Just kind of gray, most days. It's been like that for a long time now. 

I just... things I usually look forward to, like fishing, or tending the tomatoes out back, or even going to a church concert... I don't know. I still do them, but they just feel like items on a checklist now. I don't really get much enjoyment out of them anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?
A while, I guess. Um... probably since they pulled me back into full operational leadership at work. That was about two years and four months ago. So... around then, I suppose.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
Not really. I mean... work is work, I guess, but I don't sit around worrying about things. It's not really like that. Just... tired, like I said.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I... well, like I mentioned a minute ago. The fishing and the garden. I still do them, but... yeah. I guess I just don't care as much about them right now. That's about it.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?

I suppose. My wife pointed out my pants are looser lately. I'm not trying to drop weight or anything... my appetite has just been off, more days than not. I usually end up working through lunch without really noticing. And then I just sort of... pick at dinner. But yeah, I guess I've lost a little.
Have you had periods like this before in your life?
I don't know. Maybe. It's hard to say... I've always been a bit on the quiet side, I guess. Just... this is just how I am. I don't really keep track of things like that.
Have you ever felt significantly better for a while, and then gone back to feeling this way again?
I don't think so. It's just... pretty steady, I guess. I don't really notice feeling significantly better or worse. Just... kind of the same.
Have you ever felt this way, and then at some point felt completely back to normal, before feeling this way again?
I... no, I don't think so. I don't really remember a time when I felt "normal," whatever that means. It's just... this is just my life. It doesn't really change.
Have you ever thought about ending your life?
No... no, I haven't. Nothing like that.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt significantly happier and more interested in activities than you do now?
No... not really. Like I was saying before, it's always just been about the same. I don't really remember a time where I was suddenly happier or doing a lot of things. It's just... steady.
Have you ever had a period where your flat feeling and lack of interest in activities went away for a while, before coming back?
I... no. It's like I just said. It doesn't really go away. It's just... always like this.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you didn't feel this way?
I don't think so. Like I said... it's just how things are. I can't really remember it being any different.
Have you ever had a distinct period where you felt better, followed by a return of these same feelings?
No. I... look, I feel like you're asking me the exact same thing again. There are no distinct periods. It doesn't really fluctuate. It's just... a flat line. Always has been.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you felt sad or depressed most of the time?

It's not just two weeks. It's... well, for a long time now. Just this gray, flat feeling most days. 

I don't know about "sad," just... flat. Even things I used to look forward to, like fishing, or... tending the tomatoes. A church concert. They just feel like items on a checklist now. Not something I actually enjoy anymore.
Do you feel like you no longer enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable?
I... I thought I just answered that. Yeah, I don't really enjoy much of anything anymore. It's just... going through the motions.
Has your flat feeling or lack of interest in activities gotten worse over the past two years?
No, I... I don't think so. Like I said before, it's just a flat line. It hasn't really changed or gotten worse. It just... stays the same.
Have you ever had a period where you felt completely better, without this flat feeling, that lasted for at least two months?
Two months? No. I don't... I don't remember any time like that. It's just been the same.
Has your flat feeling ever completely gone away for any period of time?
No. I just... I just told you that. It hasn't gone away.
Do you think this flat feeling you've described has been present for more than two years?
Yes. It's been... about two years and four months, I guess. Right around the time I got pulled back into full operational leadership at work.
